envelope.description: Implement commit-parent workspaces and transient selected after blocks

body.title: Implement commit-parent workspaces and transient selected after blocks
body.summary: Materialize only relevant before files from each selected change's actual applicable commit parent into an attempt-owned sealed workspace and decode only exact pinned after ranges transiently for reviewer input.
acceptanceChecks: New, deleted, renamed and stacked-commit changes resolve against the actual selected commit parent rather than origin or current HEAD, with exact range and object verification.

The attempt workspace contains only relevant baseline files at ordinary paths, has a sealed integrity manifest, remains isolated between concurrent attempts, and is removed through owned terminal cleanup.
Selected after blocks include no unrelated lines and decoded bytes are released after reviewer-input construction rather than retained in checkpoints or prepared packets.

tests.name: Pinned commit-parent workspace matrix: new/delete/rename/stacked commits, exact transient after ranges, relevant-only parent files, manifest sealing, concurrent attempt isolation, cancellation and owned cleanup.
